panels.title: Protocol × Session Reachability Matrix
panels.description: Rows = client sessions, shows per-protocol connectivity verdict from each client network.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ls.session_id, COALESCE(ls.client_meta->'asn'->>'org', '—') AS client_org, pr.protocol, pr.verdict, pr.handshake_count, pr.data_transfer_ok, pr.avg_rtt_ms FROM protocol_results pr JOIN listener_sessions ls ON ls.id = pr.session_id JOIN test_runs tr ON tr.id = ls.test_run_id WHERE tr.test_id = ${test_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY ls.session_id, pr.protocol

SELECT pr.protocol, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.verdict = 'OK') AS connected, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.verdict = 'HANDSHAKE_ONLY') AS handshake_only, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.verdict = 'BLOCKED') AS blocked FROM protocol_results pr JOIN listener_sessions ls ON ls.id = pr.session_id JOIN test_runs tr ON tr.id = ls.test_run_id WHERE tr.test_id = ${test_id:sqlstring} GROUP BY pr.protocol ORDER BY connected DESC

SELECT ls.session_id, ls.started_at, ls.duration_sec, ls.client_connected, COALESCE(ls.client_meta->'asn'->>'org', '—') AS client_org, COALESCE(ls.client_meta->'location'->>'city', '—') AS city, CASE WHEN ls.client_meta->>'is_mobile' = 'true' THEN 'mobile' WHEN ls.client_meta->>'is_datacenter' = 'true' THEN 'datacenter' ELSE 'residential' END AS client_type, COUNT(pr.id) AS protocols, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.verdict='OK') AS ok_protocols FROM listener_sessions ls LEFT JOIN protocol_results pr ON pr.session_id = ls.id JOIN test_runs tr ON tr.id = ls.test_run_id WHERE tr.test_id = ${test_id:sqlstring} GROUP BY ls.id, ls.session_id, ls.started_at, ls.duration_sec, ls.client_connected, ls.client_meta ORDER BY ls.started_at DESC
